title: Russian Drone Drops Explosives on Kherson Hospital Grounds
detail: Russian forces dropped explosives from a drone onto the grounds of a hospital in Kherson's Korabelny district on the afternoon of September 18, after 14:00 local time, according to Head of Kherson City Military Administration Yaroslav Shanko. Several official and emergency medical service vehicles at the hospital were damaged; no injuries were reported. The strike follows a similar Russian drone attack on a Kherson ambulance a week earlier that injured three medical workers, part of a recurring pattern of attacks on medical facilities and personnel in the frontline city.

title: Russia Strikes Same Sloviansk District Twice in an Hour, 5 Injured
detail: Russian forces struck the same district of Sloviansk, Donetsk Oblast, twice on September 18, approximately one hour apart, injuring five civilians who received medical treatment. High-rise apartment buildings, a shop, a Nova Poshta branch, an administrative building, and pavilions at the Pryvokzalnyi market were damaged in the attacks.
